note: Anchors are EXPERT-SET, not statistically calibrated. Each metric is scored 0-10 by interpolation between anchor_0 (scores 0) and anchor_10 (scores 10); the order of the anchors gives the direction. Intensity metrics use a LOG scale because they are roughly log-normally distributed (a linear scale left 76-92% of the cohort at full marks). 'hygiene' metrics (policy exists / zero incidents) are necessary but nearly every company meets them, so they count at hygiene_weight in the pillar mean. Agent 8 reports saturation and how much the ranking moves when every anchor and weight is perturbed.

Renewable Energy Percentage.rationale: 0% renewable share is the worst case; >=60% matches leading Indian corporates (renewable-led RE100-type targets are typically 50-100%).

Energy Intensity.rationale: kWh per permanent employee on a log scale: 300 is best-in-class for office-based firms, 20,000 indicates heavy plant/tower operations.

GHG Intensity.rationale: Scope 1+2 tCO2e per INR crore revenue on a log scale: IT services emit about 0.1-1, asset-heavy firms 20-250.

Water Intensity.rationale: KL consumed per permanent employee on a log scale; office campuses are typically 3-10.

Waste Recovered Percentage.rationale: Share of generated waste that is recycled/recovered (BRSR Principle 6 KPI).

Female Employees Percentage.rationale: Women as a share of permanent employees; 40% is near-parity for the sector (cohort max 43%).

Employee Turnover Rate.rationale: Permanent-employee turnover; lower is better. Indian IT attrition has recently run 12-20%.

Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate.rationale: LTIFR per million person-hours for employees; 0 is best.

Human Rights Training Coverage.rationale: Share of employees trained on human-rights issues (BRSR Principle 5).

Differently Abled Employees Percentage.rationale: India's population share is 2.2% (cited in the CFA/NSE BRSR study); disclosed workforce share is mostly below 0.5%.

Female Directors Percentage.rationale: One woman director is the legal minimum for listed companies; 33% is a common best-practice target.

Board and KMP Disciplinary Actions.rationale: Directors/KMPs disciplined for bribery/corruption (BRSR Principle 1); any case is a red flag.

Board and KMP Conflict of Interest Compl.rationale: Complaints about conflicts of interest of directors/KMPs (BRSR Principle 1).

Board Sustainability Committee.rationale: Board-level committee responsible for sustainability decisions (yes = 10).

excluded_reason: Air quality, market performance and news are independent evidence about the company, not company-reported ESG performance (specification A6/C9). They are reported as context and used to test consistency and validation, never added to the score.
